placements.lesson_title: Number Families & the Real Number System
The Real Number System & Interval Representations

factors-and-multiples.title: Factor Structure Lab

placements.lesson_title: Optimization with Perimeter and Area Constraints

factors-and-multiples.scope_note: GCF/LCM is intentionally reserved for the existing Pre-Algebra U01-L04 game to avoid subject duplication.

prime-spy-composite.title: Prime Spy / Composite Catch
prime-spy-composite.scope_note: Geometry and Algebra II Rational Root placements were deliberately not duplicated because those lessons already have canonical shared-game companions.

gcf-lcm-challenge.title: GCF / LCM Challenge

placements.lesson_title: Greatest Common Factor & Least Common Multiple

gcf-lcm-challenge.scope_note: Geometry uses LCM only as a rotational-cycle application. Algebra I extends GCF to monomials; Algebra II extends LCM to least common denominators. No duplicate game is created.

operation-stepper.title: Operation Stepper
operation-stepper.scope_note: The shared game teaches evaluation sequence. Higher modes use formula and composition structure rather than merely larger arithmetic.

estimate-defender.title: Estimate Defender

placements.lesson_title: Precision, Rounding, Significant Figures & Percent Error

estimate-defender.scope_note: Algebra II measurement-error and modelling lessons remain available for later companions; this game owns the strongest direct progression without duplicating those future concepts.

integer-compass.title: Integer Compass
integer-compass.scope_note: Progression is signed quantity → signed rate/slope → translation vector → vector components. Integer operation games remain separate to avoid duplication.

integer-rank.title: Integer Rank

placements.lesson_title: Inequality Meaning, Number Lines & Interval Notation

integer-rank.scope_note: Integer Rank owns order/interval representation and feasibility boundaries. Absolute-value solving remains with Opposite Mirror; later function-domain or inequality-solving games should extend other concepts rather than duplicate this ordering layer.

integer-sum-lab.title: Integer Sum Lab
integer-sum-lab.scope_note: Geometry is intentionally not assigned: Integer Compass already owns signed-coordinate/vector progression there. Algebra I polynomial addition remains available for a later polynomial-specific game, avoiding duplicate subject ownership.

opposite-shift.title: Opposite Shift
opposite-shift.scope_note: Geometry intentionally omitted: Integer Compass already owns signed-coordinate/vector progression. Complex subtraction remains with the complex-operations lesson family rather than duplicating Integer Sum Lab.

dividing-integers.title: Quotient Check · Dividing Integers
dividing-integers.scope_note: This game owns quotient structure, inverse verification, and divisor/denominator restrictions. Geometry is intentionally omitted because ratio, similarity, scale, and trigonometric-ratio progressions belong to later proportional-reasoning games. Sign Forge retains multiplication/division of rational expressions so subject ownership does not overlap.

coordinated-mission-control.title: Coordinated Mission Control
coordinated-mission-control.scope_note: Integer Compass already owns Geometry U02-L01 and Algebra II U10-L10. Coordinated Mission Control is intentionally assigned to later coordinate, slope, and multi-step navigation lessons to avoid duplicate subject ownership.

equation-balance-lab.title: Equation Balance Lab

placements.lesson_title: Multi-Step Equations with Distribution & Like Terms

equation-balance-lab.scope_note: Game v1 does not interpret mode parameters; learner selects difficulty manually. Pre-Algebra L02/L03 should use Level 1; L04 Level 2; L05 Level 3 (variables on both sides is advanced enrichment). Browser QA pending.

inequality-number-line.title: Inequality Number Line

placements.lesson_title: Inequality Meaning, Number Lines & Interval Notation

inequality-number-line.scope_note: Single-boundary inequalities only; compound and systems lessons intentionally excluded. Mode query is metadata; game v1 requires manual level selection. Browser QA pending.

slope-and-rate-studio.title: Slope & Rate Studio

placements.lesson_title: Rate of Change from Tables, Graphs & Contexts

slope-and-rate-studio.scope_note: Game reads mode query and selects initial level. Lessons include broader content beyond game's practice scope. Browser QA pending; no automatic course mastery writeback.

linear-systems-mission.title: Linear Systems Mission

placements.lesson_title: Systems as Intersections & Number of Solutions

linear-systems-mission.scope_note: Graph/intersection, substitution, elimination, and classification supported. Systems of inequalities and optimization excluded. Live browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

polynomial-factoring-forge.title: Polynomial Factoring Forge
polynomial-factoring-forge.scope_note: Supports binomial expansion, monic/nonmonic quadratic factoring and zero-product solving; does not fully cover difference of squares, polynomial modelling or graph analysis. Browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

quadratic-graph-lab.title: Quadratic Graph Lab
quadratic-graph-lab.scope_note: Covers vertices, symmetry, roots, and transformations. Unit 10 Lesson 07 is supplemental only; game does not teach full projectile modelling or optimization. Browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

proof-path-builder.title: Proof Path Builder

placements.lesson_title: Parallel Lines Cut by a Transversal
Proving Lines Parallel from Angle Relationships

proof-path-builder.scope_note: Guided proof steps for angles, triangle congruence, parallel lines, and proof logic. Not an unrestricted proof editor; individual lessons may include theorems beyond this game. Live browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

transformation-plane.title: Transformation Plane

placements.lesson_title: Rotations About the Origin and Other Centers

transformation-plane.scope_note: Point-based translation, reflection, rotation, dilation and mixed practice. Lessons 04–05 use supplemental point transformations; full composition, polygon congruence and rotations about arbitrary centers are not covered. Live browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

congruence-similarity-lab.title: Congruence & Similarity Lab
congruence-similarity-lab.scope_note: Guided congruence, correspondence, similarity, and scale factor challenges. Lessons involving CPCTC proofs, center-based dilations, side-splitter theorems, and scale drawings receive supplemental practice only; no full proof or construction coverage. Live browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

circle-theorem-studio.title: Circle Theorem Studio
circle-theorem-studio.scope_note: Foundational central/inscribed angles, chords, tangents and radius relationships. U08 L01 is supplemental vocabulary practice; U08 L02 does not cover full arc-length computation. Secant power, sector area and circle equations excluded. Browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

right-triangle-trig.title: Right Triangle Trig
right-triangle-trig.scope_note: Right-triangle trigonometric ratios, missing sides, inverse trig and Pythagorean relationships. U06 L01 does not fully assess converse; U06 L07 and L08 receive supplemental numerical practice rather than complete elevation, bearings, vector, or navigation scenarios. Live browser QA and mastery writeback not certified.

function-transformation-studio.title: Function Transformation Studio
function-transformation-studio.scope_note: Two transformation depths and a separate inverse-linear mission. Local practice does not change formal grades.

exponential-logarithm-lab.title: Exponential & Logarithm Lab
exponential-logarithm-lab.scope_note: Ten distinct modes across Algebra II Unit 06 (growth, finance, continuous exponentials, equations, model fitting) and Unit 07 (log inverses, rules, equations/domains, base changes, data interpretation); independent practice only.

placements.lesson_title: Continuous Growth, Decay & the Constant e
Solving Exponential Equations by Common Bases

polynomial-zeros-explorer.title: Polynomial Zeros Explorer
polynomial-zeros-explorer.scope_note: Twelve polynomial missions covering degree, expansion, parity/end behavior, nonreal quadratic roots and conjugates, FTA, long/synthetic division, remainder and factor theorems, rational roots, distinct zeros, multiplicity, and interpolation. Standalone i-powers and complex arithmetic are reserved for Complex Plane Lab.

placements.lesson_title: Fundamental Theorem of Algebra & Complete Factorization

matrix-mission-control.title: Matrix Mission Control
matrix-mission-control.scope_note: Six modes: graphical nonlinear systems, substitution of a circle and line, radical-domain verification, 2x2 matrix operations, nonsingular row-reduced linear systems, determinants and inverse entries. Optional practice does not modify formal lesson grades.

sequence-series-studio.title: Sequence & Series Studio
sequence-series-studio.scope_note: Eight independent mathematical modes: arithmetic and geometric recursion, difference-table pattern classification, finite series, infinite geometric convergence, sigma notation, binomial coefficients, and percent-change growth. Canonical reusable game with browser-local practice and no official mastery side effects.

complex-plane-lab.title: Complex Plane Lab
complex-plane-lab.scope_note: Eight complex-number modes: signed powers of i, addition/subtraction, multiplication, conjugate division, complex quadratic zeros, conjugation, modulus/quadrant, and multiplication by i as rotations. The reusable lab replaces three introductory duplicate lesson companions, preserving their other placements and the separately linked Polynomial Zeros Explorer.

placements.lesson_title: The Imaginary Unit & Powers of i

statistics-detective.title: Statistics Detective
statistics-detective.scope_note: Eight source-free investigative modes: ethical research design, center/population SD, median/IQR box plots, least-squares regression, two-way conditional frequencies, misleading/truncated charts, normal z-scores/percentiles, and biased/random sampling. Fictional datasets, local-only practice, zero tracking or grade side effects.

placements.lesson_title: Statistical Questions, Study Design & Data Ethics
Two-Way Tables, Conditional Relative Frequency & Probability
Sampling, Bias, Margin of Error & Study Design

probability-quest.title: Probability Quest
probability-quest.scope_note: Ten self-contained probability modes: multi-stage counting, permutations, combinations, complement, union/intersection, conditional rates, independence, Bayes with true/false positives, binomial PMF and expected successes, and fair expected net value. Local-only practice, accessible graphical explanations and retry without forced restart.

unit-circle-navigator.title: Unit Circle Navigator
unit-circle-navigator.scope_note: Eight unit-circle investigation modes: exact π radians, coterminal turns, circle coordinates, acute reference angles/quadrants, symbolic sine/cosine, exact tangent with undefined detection, reciprocal sec/csc/cot, and rotations. Free 15°-step workshop has safe numerical fallbacks for non-special angles; offline local practice never changes official grades.

trigonometric-wave-studio.title: Trigonometric Wave Studio
trigonometric-wave-studio.scope_note: Nine wave investigation modes: sine/cosine values, amplitude/midline, period/frequency, phase, extrema/vertical shifts, tan/cot/sec/csc asymptotes, inverse trig restricted principal branches, sinusoidal least-squares data fitting, and tangent/cotangent values. Live free wave workshop with amplitude/frequency/phase/midline sliders, accessible SVG chart, local-only 80% practice tracking, JSON export, no third parties or grading side effects.

placements.lesson_title: Graphs of Tangent, Cotangent, Secant & Cosecant

trigonometric-identity-forge.title: Trigonometric Identity Forge
trigonometric-identity-forge.scope_note: Nine trigonometric-identity and equation pathways: Pythagorean, reciprocal, quotient, symbolic proof transformations, sum, difference, double angle, half angle with signs, and two-solution trig equations on [0°,360°). Offline SVG coordinate evidence, no false claim that numerical samples constitute proof; local per-lesson 80% first-try practice and JSON export; no official grade or STOS interactions.
